Subtracting 10 weeks and 1 day means subtracting 71 days.  
1138 is not a leap year (divisible by 2 but not by 4).  
From 10-29 back 71 days: October has 31 days, September 30, August 31, July 31.  
29 Oct → 1 Oct is 28 days back, 43 more days back from 1 Oct lands in August.
